name: WriteToExcelArrayValues
label: Write Array Values to Excel Worksheet
description: Writes a value or array of values to a row or range in an Excel worksheet.

fields.name: WorksheetInstance
fields.label: Worksheet Instance
fields.description: The target Excel Worksheet object where data will be written.

fields.name: ValueToWrite
fields.label: Value(s) To Write
fields.description: A single value, or an array/list of values to write across columns.

fields.name: WriteMode
fields.label: Write Mode
fields.description: Specifies how to determine the target cell(s) for writing.

selectOptions.label: On Specified Cell
selectOptions.description: Writes to a specific cell by column and row.

selectOptions.label: On Currently Active Cell
selectOptions.description: Writes to the currently active cell.

fields.name: Column
fields.label: Column
fields.description: Starting column letter (e.g., 'A'). Used if ColumnIndex not provided.

fields.name: ColumnIndex
fields.label: Column Index
fields.description: Starting column index (1 = A). Takes precedence if > 0.

fields.name: Name
fields.label: Name
fields.description: The name of the named range to write to (required if 'Write Mode' is 'On Named Cells').

fields.name: PopulateEntireRange
fields.label: Populate Entire Range
fields.description: If true, populates the entire named range with the same value.
